changelog:
- Initial release: Transform CSV data into interactive HTML chart visualizations with Chart.js.
- Supports auto-detection of best chart type based on your data.
- Generate single charts or multi-chart dashboards from CSV files.
- Flexible command-line interface with custom chart types, axes, colors, titles, and themes.
- Output charts feature animations, color palettes, theme toggle, PNG download, responsive design, and smart tooltips.
- Read CSV input from files or via stdin for streamlined workflows.
summary: Transform CSV data into stunning interactive chart visualizations with Chart.js
